instruction: Match the words to their definition.

items.questionText: Forbid
items.correctAnswer: To prohibit or order not to do something

items.questionText: Prospective
items.correctAnswer: expected to be the specified thing in the future; likely to happen at a future date

items.questionText: Dynamic
items.correctAnswer: A person or thing that causes admiration due to being full of energy and new ideas

items.questionText: Sustainable
items.correctAnswer: An action or policy that will not deplete resources or cause long-term damage

items.questionText: Maintain
items.correctAnswer: To keep something in a particular state or condition

items.questionText: Rule
items.correctAnswer: An authoritative direction or instruction; to exercise authority or control

items.questionText: Property
items.correctAnswer: Something that belongs to someone; something owned; a quality or characteristic of something

items.questionText: Rewarding
Principle

items.questionText: Apparent

items.questionText: Claim
items.correctAnswer: To declare something as one's own; an assertion of the truth of something

items.questionText: Threat
items.correctAnswer: A statement of intention to cause pain, injury, or damage

items.questionText: Rate
items.correctAnswer: The speed at which something happens or changes

instruction: Use the word in parentheses at the end of each sentence to form a word that fits in the blanks.

items.questionText: 1. Charities such as Oxfam are always trying to recruit _____________ to help in their work. (VOLUNTARILY)

items.questionText: 1. Have you ever used a manual to assemble something? What was it? Can you describe your experience?
2. Can you explain a natural phenomenon that fascinates you?

5. Who is a person who has made an impact on your life?
6. Do you pay attention to the stock market? Why or why not?
7. What activities or hobbies do you find most amusing?
8. Why do you think people sometimes deceive others? Is it ever justified?
